learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concepts and techniques of differential calculus in Rn.
Apply differentiability in the study of optimization.
Understand the definitions and compute integrals in Rn.
Apply double and triple integrals in the calculation of areas, volumes, center of mass, and probability density.
Understand the definitions of vector calculus and apply the theorems of vector analysis to physics problems.

syllabus_topics: the chain rule and the backpropagation algorithm
higher order derivatives and Taylor's formula
numerical methods: steepest descent and Newton's method
applications of integration to compute areas, volumes centers of mass and probability density
numerical methods: numerical integration (Monte Carlo method)
the theorems of Green, Stokes, divergence
physical applications: Newton's gravity, electricity, magnetism

assessment_methods.method: Test (written test carried out in the 1st assessment period)

assessment_rules: Students can choose between two evaluation methods: assessment throughout the semester or assessment by exam. For assessment throughout the semester, mini-tests in class account for 30% and a test accounts for 70%. For assessment by exam, a final exam accounts for 100%. The responsible professors reserve the right to conduct an oral examination complementary to any assessment component.
